data.title: Lawyers’ Committee Files Lawsuit on Behalf of Black Students Detained and Searched Due to AI Alert Falsely Identifying a Bag of Chips as a Firearm
data.description: Case focuses on alleged failures surrounding AI systems and impact on students BALTIMORE COUNTY, MD – Today, the Lawyers’ Committee for Civil Rights Under Law filed a lawsuit on behalf of four Black current and former students against Omnilert, LLC, Baltimore County Public Schools (BCPS) and personnel, the Baltimore County Police Department, and individual officers […]
